spīcula, spīculōrum n. pl.

noun, second declension, plural

“Points”, spearheads: classically the point of a dart or arrow (Cic. Fam. 5.12.5), as the French name piques means pikes. Vives also calls them vōmercula seu pālās.

Other words

  • pāla, pālae f.

    noun, first declension · also used · modern · Traupman 51; Traupman 286

    Classically a spade (Cato, Liv.), as in the English name.

See also suit, hearts, diamonds, clubs.
